data.gender_notes: Ranjeeta is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Ranjeeta is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Ranjana', which means 'joyful, radiant'. In Hindu mythology, Ranjita is considered a form of the goddess Saraswati, who is the goddess of knowledge, learning, wisdom, and the arts. The name Ranjeeta carries the meaning “Joyful, Radiant” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Ranjeeta usually hope their child will grow to embody joyful, radiant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
